entries.wording: 货物电子信息已经收到
entries.note: The platform's order row: the shipment's data received, before or just after the warehouse has the parcel.
The Guangzhou warehouse takes the parcel in; the receiving point is where the shipper hands it over.

entries.wording: 货物已交机场,等待航班安排中
entries.english: Handed to the airport, awaiting a flight
entries.note: Handed to the export airport before a flight is booked.

entries.wording: The instruction data for this shipment have been provided by the sender to DHL electronically
entries.note: Copied from DHL on the line into Germany: the parcel announced to DHL, on DHL's wall clock, before the flight.

entries.wording: The shipment is in transit to DHL
entries.note: Copied from DHL: the parcel is on its way to DHL, which does not have it yet.

entries.wording: 货物已交机场，预计…号的航班
entries.english: Handed to the airport, booked on the flight of the …
entries.note: Handed to the airport, with the day of the month of the booked flight, which the map reads as an ellipsis and the English names as an ordinal.

entries.english: Flight departed, expected to land on the …
entries.note: The flight has left, with the day of the month it should land, read as an ellipsis.

entries.english: Flight delayed, expected to land on the …
entries.note: The flight is late, with the day of the month it should now land, read as an ellipsis. The parcel is on its way all the same.

entries.wording: 航班落地，拆板中 Flight landing, dismantling board in progress
entries.note: Landed in Amsterdam: the flight's pallets are broken down.

entries.wording: 已提货，清关中 The goods have been picked up and are currently undergoing customs clearance
entries.note: Collected at the destination airport and in import clearance.

entries.wording: 清关延误，目前还在排队清关中
entries.english: Customs clearance delayed, still queuing for clearance
entries.note: Import clearance running late, the parcel still waiting its turn.

entries.wording: 清关完成，待转运Customs clearance completed, awaiting transfer
entries.note: Cleared; the parcel waits to move on.
On its way from Amsterdam towards the delivery carrier.

entries.wording: 待交服务商awaiting delivery to the service provider
entries.note: Waiting to be handed to the delivery carrier, which the row does not name.

entries.wording: 已交服务商Delivered to service provider
entries.note: Handed to the delivery carrier, DHL on the line into Germany; the parcel is not delivered.

entries.wording: The shipment has been processed in the parcel center of origin
The shipment arrived in the region of recipient and will be transported to the delivery base in the next step.
The shipment has been loaded onto the delivery vehicle
The shipment has been successfully delivered
